assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated building sprite for an original Japanese top-down pixel RPG visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. This is a game asset, not an illustration or full scene. Orthographic north-facing street elevation viewed from above at a fixed three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facade facing directly down to player, horizontal facade baseline, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background with no floor, no shadow beyond building footprint, no people, no text or logos. Entire building visible and centered with transparent margins. Simplify details to remain readable when scaled down in a 16px-grid game. Original pixel drawing based on supplied reference architecture, do not paste photo pixels. REFERENCE ROLE: architecture reference only. Subject Takanawa Gateway Station. Preserve its distinctive long white folded origami roof, triangular truss rhythm, glass concourse and cream/wood supports. Simplify to a small iconic station with three folded peaks, centered front entrance and two clear front doors, no surrounding skyscrapers, railway or plaza. Wide building approx 3:2 footprint. Intended game display 192x128 logical pixels.
